recognize_zh: 這是一支紫頭 EDTA 採血管的照片，傾斜後管壁上沾滿一粒一粒的紅色顆粒狀凝集物，而不是均勻的全血，代表室溫下紅血球已經凝集（體外冷凝集），加溫到 37°C 通常會散開。
features: Photograph of a lavender-top (EDTA) blood collection tube held horizontally
Coarse granular red clumps coating the inner tube wall instead of a smooth uniform film
Visible macroscopic agglutinates at room temperature
No fibrin clot or gross hemolysis evident
describe_en: Gross photograph of an EDTA-anticoagulated whole blood tube shows coarse, granular red cell aggregates coating the inner tube wall when the tube is tilted, rather than a smooth homogeneous film. This macroscopic agglutination at room temperature indicates in vitro cryoagglutination due to a cold agglutinin. Warming the tube to 37°C should disperse the agglutinates, and a repeat CBC on a pre-warmed sample corrects spurious results such as low RBC count, falsely high MCV and MCHC. A true clot would appear as a single cohesive fibrin mass rather than dispersed granules.

ddx.vs: A clotted sample shows a cohesive fibrin clot or strands that do not disperse with warming.
Cryoproteins cause a gel or precipitate in plasma after cooling rather than granular red-cell clumps, and cryofibrinogen is seen in plasma but not serum.
Rouleaux cause rapid sedimentation but not grossly visible granular clumps on the tube wall.
